brief: GS sales desk weekly roundup (Dioni Ellinikaki), ten items, no single thesis. Rates: US 10yr yields hit 5.25% before softer data eased Fed-tightening expectations; GS's Mericle pushed the next hike from October to December after soft August core PCE and now sees a strong chance no further hikes are needed, a call Marshall says today's soft payrolls, downward revisions and weak wages reinforce, pointing to renewed duration support despite credit stress; Tony P calls higher rates a headwind, not a wrecking ball, conditional on earnings growth holding. Hedge fund monitor: Global Fundamental L/S fell 0.55% in September (YTD +12.6%), with the largest European net buying in 5+ years and a US rotation into TMT while other sectors were sold. Agentic AI: GS adds Amazon to its Conviction List on AWS growth, a ~$70bn Physical AI opportunity and ad strength; sees agentic commerce as a 3-5yr trend; flags 5-20% medium-term FCF risk to telcos from reduced customer inertia, though the telco team stays bullish. Conviction List changes span Europe, US, APAC. BASF's rejected €10bn Evonik approach faces EC phase-2 risk, 12m+ to close. Also: Buy SalMar, Sika margin upside into 2027, Zegona 70% upside.
